name: hopdesk
description: A fast, friendly remote desktop client for Linux

scripts.build: npm -w @hopdesk/crypto run build && npm -w @hopdesk/protocol run build && npm -w @hopdesk/transport run build && npm -w @hopdesk/core run build && npm -w @hopdesk/desktop run build
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/crypto && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/transport && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron apps/desktop/dist/main.js
scripts.test:packages: npm -w @hopdesk/crypto run test && npm -w @hopdesk/protocol run test && npm -w @hopdesk/transport run test && npm -w @hopdesk/core run test
